<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="2" stdDeviation="3" flood-color="#DCDCDC" flood-opacity="0.8"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F3F2F7"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="25" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="20" y="17" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="12px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">9:41</text>
    <line x1="327" y1="16" x2="331" y2="16" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="334" y1="14" x2="338" y2="14" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="341" y1="12" x2="345" y2="12" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="354" cy="14" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="351" y1="14" x2="357" y2="14" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="1"/>
    <rect x="365" y="9" width="19" height="11" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="367" y="11" width="14" height="7" rx="1" fill="#110053"/>
    <rect x="385" y="12" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#110053"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="25" width="390" height="62" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <polyline points="31,56 23,56 31,48" fill="none" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="23" y1="56" x2="39" y2="56" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="55" y="62" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="19px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Pasajeros</text>
    <line x1="0" y1="86" x2="390" y2="86" stroke="#E0E0E2" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Main content -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="121" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="21px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">¿Quiénes viajan?</text>
    <text x="20" y="146" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Selecciona la cantidad de pasajeros</text>

    <!-- Informative youth banner -->
    <g>
      <rect x="18" y="166" width="354" height="82" rx="7" fill="#EFEDFA"/>
      <circle cx="43" cy="193" r="17" fill="#4658E0"/>
      <circle cx="43" cy="188" r="2.2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <line x1="43" y1="193" x2="43" y2="202" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <text x="70" y="190" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="14px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">¿Tienes entre 12 y 27 años?</text>
      <text x="70" y="211" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="13px" font-weight="400" fill="#110053">Conoce las tarifas especiales para jóvenes</text>
      <text x="70" y="230" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="13px" font-weight="700" fill="#9747FF">Descubre más</text>
      <polyline points="153,226 158,230 153,234" fill="none" stroke="#9747FF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Selection card shadow and card -->
    <rect x="18" y="270" width="354" height="270" rx="7" fill="#DCDCDC" opacity="0.55"/>
    <g filter="url(#shadow)">
      <rect x="18" y="268" width="354" height="270" rx="7" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E0E0E2" stroke-width="1"/>

      <!-- Adult row -->
      <g>
        <circle cx="48" cy="315" r="18" fill="#EFEDFA"/>
        <circle cx="48" cy="310" r="5" fill="#110053"/>
        <ellipse cx="48" cy="322" rx="9" ry="5" fill="#110053"/>
        <text x="79" y="312" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="16px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Adultos</text>
        <text x="79" y="332" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="12px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Desde 12 años</text>
        <g>
          <rect x="230" y="299" width="36" height="36" rx="100" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D1D1D2" stroke-width="1"/>
          <line x1="241" y1="317" x2="255" y2="317" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        </g>
        <text x="285" y="323" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="18px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">1</text>
        <g>
          <rect x="304" y="299" width="36" height="36" rx="100" fill="#EA104C"/>
          <line x1="315" y1="317" x2="329" y2="317" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
          <line x1="322" y1="310" x2="322" y2="324" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        </g>
      </g>
      <line x1="34" y1="359" x2="356" y2="359" stroke="#E0E0E2" stroke-width="1"/>

      <!-- Children row -->
      <g>
        <circle cx="48" cy="404" r="18" fill="#EFEDFA"/>
        <circle cx="48" cy="399" r="4.5" fill="#110053"/>
        <ellipse cx="48" cy="411" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#110053"/>
        <text x="79" y="401" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="16px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Niños</text>
        <text x="79" y="421" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="12px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">De 2 a 11 años</text>
        <g>
          <rect x="230" y="388" width="36" height="36" rx="100" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D1D1D2" stroke-width="1"/>
          <line x1="241" y1="406" x2="255" y2="406" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        </g>
        <text x="285" y="412" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="18px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">0</text>
        <g>
          <rect x="304" y="388" width="36" height="36" rx="100" fill="#EA104C"/>
          <line x1="315" y1="406" x2="329" y2="406" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
          <line x1="322" y1="399" x2="322" y2="413" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        </g>
      </g>
      <line x1="34" y1="449" x2="356" y2="449" stroke="#E0E0E2" stroke-width="1"/>

      <!-- Infants row -->
      <g>
        <circle cx="48" cy="494" r="18" fill="#EFEDFA"/>
        <circle cx="48" cy="489" r="4" fill="#110053"/>
        <ellipse cx="48" cy="501" rx="9" ry="5" fill="#110053"/>
        <text x="79" y="491" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="16px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Infantes</text>
        <text x="79" y="511" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="12px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Menores de 2 años</text>
        <g>
          <rect x="230" y="478" width="36" height="36" rx="100" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D1D1D2" stroke-width="1"/>
          <line x1="241" y1="496" x2="255" y2="496" stroke="#110053" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        </g>
        <text x="285" y="502" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="18px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">0</text>
        <g>
          <rect x="304" y="478" width="36" height="36" rx="100" fill="#EA104C"/>
          <line x1="315" y1="496" x2="329" y2="496" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
          <line x1="322" y1="489" x2="322" y2="503" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        </g>
      </g>
    </g>

    <text x="20" y="574" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="13px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Un adulto debe acompañar a cada infante.</text>

    <!-- Summary chip -->
    <g>
      <rect x="18" y="598" width="354" height="48" rx="7" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D1D1D2" stroke-width="1"/>
      <circle cx="42" cy="622" r="12" fill="#0BAEAF"/>
      <polyline points="36,622 40,626 48,617" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <text x="65" y="627" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="14px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">1 pasajero seleccionado</text>
      <text x="349" y="627" text-anchor="end" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="13px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Editar</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom action area -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="666" width="390" height="94" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="666" x2="390" y2="666" stroke="#E0E0E2" stroke-width="1"/>
    <g>
      <rect x="14" y="687" width="362" height="51" rx="7" fill="#EA104C"/>
      <text x="195" y="719" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="17px" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Confirmar</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Navigation bar -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="760" width="390" height="84" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="760" x2="390" y2="760" stroke="#E0E0E2" stroke-width="1"/>

    <!-- Inicio -->
    <g>
      <polygon points="39,786 48,778 57,786" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <rect x="42" y="785" width="12" height="11" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <text x="48" y="816" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="11px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Inicio</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Buscar -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="125" cy="787" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <line x1="131" y1="793" x2="137" y2="799" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <text x="125" y="816" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="11px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Buscar</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Viajes selected -->
    <g>
      <rect x="184" y="777" width="31" height="22" rx="5" fill="#EFEDFA"/>
      <rect x="191" y="783" width="17" height="12" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#9747FF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <line x1="194" y1="787" x2="205" y2="787" stroke="#9747FF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <text x="199" y="816" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="11px" font-weight="700" fill="#9747FF">Viajes</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Beneficios -->
    <g>
      <polygon points="282,777 286,785 295,786 288,792 290,801 282,796 274,801 276,792 269,786 278,785" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <text x="282" y="816" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="11px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Beneficios</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Cuenta -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="350" cy="784" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <ellipse cx="350" cy="798" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <text x="350" y="816" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="11px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Cuenta</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
